sentences.ar: بيوم شتوي بارد، أبوي كان مريض كتير.
sentences.en: One cold winter day, my father was very ill.

sentences.ar: وأنا كنت لحالي بالنزل.
sentences.en: And I was alone at the inn.

sentences.ar: الكابتن طلع يمشي عالشط، زي كل صبح.
sentences.en: The Captain had gone out to walk on the shore, as he did every morning.

sentences.ar: فتح الباب، ودخل زلمة ما شفته قبل.
sentences.en: The door opened, and a man I had never seen came in.

sentences.ar: كان شاحب وسمين، وناقص منه إصبعين من إيده الشمال.
sentences.en: He was pale and fat, and two fingers were missing from his left hand.

sentences.ar: ما كان شكله بحري، بس كان فيه إشي من البحر.
sentences.en: He did not look like a sailor, but there was something of the sea about him.

sentences.ar: طلب كاسة رم، وسألني: هاي الطاولة لصاحبي بيل؟
sentences.en: He ordered a glass of rum, and asked me: is this table for my friend Bill?

sentences.ar: قلت له: ما بعرف بيل.
sentences.en: I told him: I do not know any Bill.

sentences.ar: عنا واحد اسمه الكابتن.
sentences.en: We have someone called the Captain.

sentences.ar: قال: الكابتن؟
sentences.en: He said: the Captain?

sentences.ar: عنده ندبة على خده، صح؟
sentences.en: He has a scar on his cheek, right?

sentences.ar: قلت: صح.
sentences.en: I said: right.

sentences.ar: ضحك ضحكة ما عجبتني، وقال: هاد بيل.
sentences.en: He laughed a laugh I did not like, and said: that is Bill.

sentences.ar: وين هو؟
sentences.en: Where is he?

sentences.ar: قلت: طالع يمشي، ورح يرجع قريب.
sentences.en: I said: he is out walking, and he will be back soon.

sentences.ar: قال: منيح.
sentences.en: He said: good.

sentences.ar: بستناه هون.
sentences.en: I will wait for him here.

sentences.ar: رح يفرح فيّ.
sentences.en: He will be glad to see me.

sentences.ar: وقعد ورا الباب، بمكان ما بيبان منه.
sentences.en: And he sat behind the door, in a place where he could not be seen.

sentences.ar: بعد شوي، دخل الكابتن.
sentences.en: A little later, the Captain came in.

sentences.ar: مشى لطاولته، وما شاف الزلمة.
sentences.en: He walked to his table, and did not see the man.

sentences.ar: قال الزلمة من وراه: بيل.
sentences.en: The man said from behind him: Bill.

sentences.ar: الكابتن التفت، ووجهه صار أبيض زي الحيط.
sentences.en: The Captain turned, and his face went as white as the wall.

sentences.ar: قال: الكلب الأسود!
sentences.en: He said: Black Dog!

sentences.ar: قال الزلمة: هو أنا.
sentences.en: The man said: it is me.

sentences.ar: الكلب الأسود إجا يزور صاحبه القديم بيلي.
sentences.en: Black Dog has come to visit his old friend Billy.

sentences.ar: قال الكابتن: طيب، شو بدك؟
sentences.en: The Captain said: fine, what do you want?

sentences.ar: قال الكلب الأسود: نحكي.
sentences.en: Black Dog said: to talk.

sentences.ar: بس الأول، يا ولد، اطلع برا.
sentences.en: But first, boy, get out.

sentences.ar: طلعت، بس وقفت ورا الباب وسمعت.
sentences.en: I went out, but I stood behind the door and listened.

sentences.ar: بالأول كانوا يحكوا واطي، وما فهمت غير كلمات.
sentences.en: At first they talked low, and I understood only words.

sentences.ar: وبعدين علا الصوت، وسمعت الكابتن يصرخ: لا، لا، لا!
sentences.en: And then the voices rose, and I heard the Captain shout: no, no, no!

sentences.ar: وبعدين صار صوت كراسي، وصوت سيوف.
sentences.en: And then there was the sound of chairs, and the sound of swords.

sentences.ar: فتحت الباب وشفت الاتنين واقفين، وبإيد كل واحد سيف.
sentences.en: I opened the door and saw the two standing, a sword in each one's hand.

sentences.ar: الكلب الأسود كان بينزف من كتفه.
sentences.en: Black Dog was bleeding from his shoulder.

sentences.ar: هرب من الباب، وركض عالطريق، واختفى.
sentences.en: He fled out the door, ran up the road, and disappeared.

sentences.ar: والكابتن وقف مكانه، ومسك الحيط، ووقع عالأرض.
sentences.en: And the Captain stood where he was, held the wall, and fell to the floor.
